name: echo-tag
description: Echo Tag — a 3-minute multiplayer browser tag game where your last 3 seconds of movement become a solid obstacle.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @echo-tag/shared && npm run build -w @echo-tag/server && npm run build -w @echo-tag/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bench:sim
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run size && npm run check:browser
scripts.package: VITE_CHAT=off npm run build && cd Echo-Tag-Frontend/dist && rm -f ../../echo-tag-poki.zip && zip -qr ../../echo-tag-poki.zip . -x '*.map' -x '*.br' -x '*.gz' && cd ../.. && echo 'echo-tag-poki.zip (chat disabled pending Poki approval):' && du -h echo-tag-poki.zip && if grep -rqs 'localhost:2567' Echo-Tag-Frontend/dist/a; then echo '!! VITE_WS_ORIGIN is localhost: QUICK MATCH/HOST/JOIN will fail on Poki (PLAY/bots still works). Deploy the server behind wss and rebuild — docs/POKI_DEPLOY.md'; fi
scripts.package:web: npm run build && rm -rf .tmp-webdist && cp -R Echo-Tag-Frontend/dist .tmp-webdist && node -e "const f='.tmp-webdist/index.html';const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n').filter(l=>!l.includes('poki-sdk')).join('\n'))" && cd .tmp-webdist && rm -f ../echo-tag-web.zip && zip -qr ../echo-tag-web.zip . -x '*.map' -x '*.br' -x '*.gz' && cd .. && rm -rf .tmp-webdist && echo 'echo-tag-web.zip (portal-neutral, no Poki SDK):' && du -h echo-tag-web.zip
